affinity.notes: Ice and water form most of the creature and dominate the image, producing an overt unexplained elemental affinity.

anatomy.notes: Head and arms read, but the entire lower form is an indistinct elemental vortex.

archetype.notes: Sovereign area-control caster communicates the boundary-monarch duty.

counterplay.notes: Raised arms and the large curling wave visibly telegraph a major area attack before impact.

framing.notes: Scale and central dominance are communicated strongly.

identity.notes: Colossal wraith or lich identifies the Death Sovereign form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T5; exact intended tier is T5.
